body:
Hello, my friend!

The cart is packed and ready. But how will it get to the Bellhaven road? Let's plan the way on Sam's map.

Meet me on the north road.
summary: Plan the cart's way to the Bellhaven road.
done: The cart is on its way to Bellhaven!

tasks.where: on the north road out of the village
in the paddock by the mill
